name: wd-wright
description: Wright Traffic Control web, desktop, and mobile platform scaffold

scripts.test:backend:smoke: node scripts/backend-smoke.mjs && node --check functions/backend-core.js && node --check functions/operations-services.js && node --check functions/data-document-services.js && node --check functions/index.js
scripts.deploy:functions: echo "Firebase Functions are disabled until wd-wright-traffic is upgraded to Blaze."
scripts.sync:android: npm run build:android && npx cap sync android
scripts.deploy:hosting: node scripts/guard-deploy.mjs && npm run build:hosting && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting --project wd-wright-traffic
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build:ios && npx cap sync ios
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:desktop && npm run prepare:windows-stage && electron-builder --projectDir .desktop-build --win nsis
scripts.pack:win: npm run build:desktop && npm run prepare:windows-stage && electron-builder --projectDir .desktop-build --dir --win
